app.name: Sightread
badge.incomplete.tooltip: Fewer than half the notes came through, so this one's capped at {cap}.
results.practice.tooltip: Practice. Repeats earn a little XP the first time each day, then none.
welcome.headline: Read it. Play it. See how it went.
welcome.body: Real music, a few bars at a time. We listen while you play and show you every note.
onboarding.mic.title: Let the app hear you play
onboarding.mic.body: We listen while you play so we can mark each note. Sound is analysed on this device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
onboarding.level.placement: Find my level ({count} short excerpts, about {minutes} minutes)
onboarding.calibration.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad, takes earn XP only after this check.
calibrate.intro: Your speakers and mic add a small delay. We'll measure it so "late" really means late.
calibrate.loopback.intro: Stay quiet for about {seconds} seconds while we time the clicks.
calibrate.loopback.success: Your setup adds {ms} ms. We'll correct for it.
calibrate.playAlong.intro: Play a short note on each click. {clicks} clicks.
calibrate.audibility.question: Can you hear the click clearly while you play a note?
calibrate.audibility.hint: Try the Wood click, or wired headphones.
calibrate.fail.loopback: We couldn't hear the clicks. Turn up the volume, or play along instead.
calibrate.fail.estimate: Timing can't be trusted with an estimate, so takes won't earn XP until you calibrate.
calibrate.warn.bluetooth: This looks like Bluetooth audio, which adds a lot of delay. Takes won't earn XP. Wired headphones or built-in speakers work better.
calibrate.warn.airpods: AirPods microphones reduce accuracy. Use the iPhone mic.
calibrate.warn.aec: Your device seems to be filtering the microphone, which can hide quiet notes and blur timing.
scan.cover: Take a moment to read before you play. Keep your eyes ahead. Every mark waits for you after the take.
scan.ranked.notice: You'll have {seconds} seconds to read, then the count-in starts by itself. Want more time? Switch to Practice.
scan.practice.timeUp: Scan time's up. Start when ready.
scan.overflow.aboutMusic: About this music (shows title and composer)
scan.wakeLockHint: Set Auto-Lock to Never while you practise (Settings > Display & Brightness).
scan.tuning.result: You're {cents} cents {direction}. We'll allow for that.
scan.windowTooShort: Make the window taller to see the next line
stars.title: STARS
stars.signatures.title: Signatures
stars.signatures.prompt: Say the key and its sharps or flats; what gets the beat and how many per bar.
stars.tempo.title: Tempo
stars.tempo.prompt: How one beat feels; hear the click.
stars.accidentals.title: Accidentals
stars.accidentals.prompt: Find every accidental; note where the barline cancels it.
stars.rhythms.title: Rhythms
stars.rhythms.prompt: Find the hardest bar; count it silently once.
stars.signs.title: Signs and shape
stars.signs.prompt: Highest and lowest note, leaps, clef, dynamics, the ending.
play.status.noSignal: We can't hear you. Move closer to the mic?
play.status.lostPlace: Lost your place? Rejoin at the next bar line.
play.status.comeIn: Keep going: come in at bar {n}
play.stopConfirm.ranked.afterNote: Stop now? This take will be scored as it stands.
play.stopConfirm.practice: Stop this take? Stopped practice takes aren't scored.
a11y.countIn.announce: Count-in, then play. Press Escape to stop.
a11y.screenReader.headphones: Screen reader on? Use headphones so speech isn't heard as notes.
a11y.grade.heading: Grade {grade}, {score} out of 100, {stars, plural, one {# star} other {# stars}}
a11y.note: Bar {bar}, beat {beat}, written {written} {value} note, you played {played}, {timing}, {verdict}
grade.D: Rough one. Stay at this level for now.
grade.F: This one was a stretch. Try an easier level?
ranked.reason.seen-before: You've seen this excerpt before, so it isn't sight reading any more.
ranked.reason.scan-extended: The scan ran past the level's time.
ranked.reason.tempo-below-90pct: The tempo was below this level's range.
ranked.reason.calibration: Calibrate to earn XP on this device.
ranked.reason.measurement: The audio check didn't pass for this take.
ranked.reason.familiar: This tune is widely known, so it's practice.
ranked.reason.skip-limit: This one came after a skip, so it's practice.
results.rejudged: {n, plural, one {# note re-judged after the take} other {# notes re-judged after the take}}
results.rejudged.why: Listening live has a fraction of a second to decide. After the take we look at the whole performance.
results.rejudged.banner: Several marks changed after the take. Check your mic position.
results.banner.recheckShift: Your audio delay changed. Recalibrate for fair timing.
results.banner.clipping: The mic was overloaded, so some notes may be misjudged. Move back a little or play softer.
results.counts.wrong: {n, plural, one {# wrong note} other {# wrong notes}}
results.inspector.marginal: On time, {ms} ms late (a little credit lost)
results.inspector.reJudged: During the take this showed as {was}. Looking at the whole take, it was on time.
results.inspector.voiceOctave: Sung an octave lower (counts as right)
results.stops: Stops: {n} (bar {bar}, {beats, plural, one {# beat} other {# beats}})
results.drift.behind: Drifted {ms} ms behind by the end
results.drift.ahead: Drifted {ms} ms ahead by the end
results.restart: Restarted at bar {bar} ({n, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} replayed)
component.notes.label: Notes
component.notes.explain: Right notes, and no extra ones.
component.inTune.label: In tune
component.inTune.explain: How close your right notes were to the centre of the pitch.
component.rhythm.label: Rhythm
component.rhythm.explain: Notes starting on time, and long notes held for their value.
xp.headline: +{xp} XP
xp.factor.streak: Streak {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ×{value}
xp.none.repeat: No XP: you've repeated this excerpt today.
xp.none.incomplete: No XP: fewer than half the notes came through.
xp.randomHint: Random key, meter and tempo: +{percent}% XP
rank.bar: {rank} · Rank {n} of {total} · {xp} / {next} XP to {nextRank} · needs level {level}
rankup.headline: New rank: {rank}!
level.offer: You're reading level {level} well. Move up to level {next}?
level.autoUp: Moved up to level {level}: {n} takes in a row at {score} or more.
level.down: Level {level} has been a stretch lately. A few takes at level {lower} can build the reading back up.
streak.atRisk: {n, plural, one {# more ranked take} other {# more ranked takes}} today keeps your {days}-day streak.
streak.status: Streak {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} (best {best})
streak.needs: A streak day needs {n, plural, one {# ranked take} other {# ranked takes}}.
install.coach: Add Sightread to your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It keeps your progress safe and the screen awake.
home.today: Streak {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {takes, plural, one {# take} other {# takes}} · {xp} XP today
home.keyRandom: Any key up to {max} sharps or flats
home.meterTooltip: Not enough music in {meter} at this level yet
home.selector.noUnseen: Level {level} has no unseen music in {meter} for {instrument} yet.
tips.incomplete: That one got away. Keep the beat going next time, even through slips.
progress.slips.title: Common slips
empty.progress.title: Your progress starts with one take
empty.progress.body: Play an excerpt and your score, level and rank show up here.
empty.history.title: No takes yet
empty.history.body: Every take you play is saved on this device.
empty.historyFiltered.title: No takes match these filters
empty.historyFiltered.body: Try another instrument, or show practice takes too.
empty.slips.title: Not enough takes yet
empty.slips.body: After a few takes we'll show the slips you make most.
empty.selector.title: No excerpt fits these settings
permission.denied.title: Microphone is blocked. The app can't hear you play.
permission.denied.chrome: Click the icon left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then reload.
permission.denied.safariMac: Safari > Settings for This Website > Microphone > Allow.
permission.denied.iosSafari: Tap aA in the address bar > Website Settings > Microphone > Allow, then reload. Or Settings > Apps > Safari > Microphone.
permission.denied.iosHomeScreen: Close and reopen the app, then tap Allow when asked.
permission.denied.firefox: Click the crossed-out mic in the address bar, remove the block, then reload.
permission.noDevice: We can't find a microphone. Plug one in or check your system settings.
permission.busy: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
permission.insecure: The microphone only works on a secure (https) page.
void.interrupted: The take was interrupted, so it wasn't graded.
void.noSignal: We couldn't hear you, so this take wasn't graded.
void.deviceChange: The microphone or speakers changed during the take. Recalibrate, then try again.
void.backlog: This device fell behind while listening, so the take wasn't graded. Close other apps and try again.
void.captureGap: This device fell behind while listening, so the take wasn't graded. Close other apps and try again.
banner.calibrateNeeded: Calibrate once so timing grades are fair. It takes {seconds} seconds.
banner.bluetooth: This looks like Bluetooth audio, which adds a lot of delay. Takes won't earn XP. Wired headphones or built-in speakers work better.
banner.storageLoss: Your progress on this device was cleared by the browser. If you have a backup, import it.
error.storageBlocked: This browser isn't saving your progress (private browsing or storage full).
error.corpus: Couldn't load the music library. Check your connection; after the first visit it works offline.
error.clockRate: Audio setup problem. Please reload the page.
error.importInvalid: That file isn't a Sightread backup.
error.noAudioWorklet: This browser can't run the listening engine. Use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
settings.title: Settings
settings.profile.name: Your name
settings.display.cents: Show cents and milliseconds in review
settings.about.privacy: Audio never leaves this device. Nothing is recorded.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.question: Shortcut list
dialog.skip.title: Skip this one? It counts as seen.
dialog.skip.practiceNotice: Your next excerpt will be practice: one skip per {n} ranked takes.
